text:
joanne: kicking off config-only deploy for routing + batching + timeouts. change window 23:00-00:00 PST. canary 5% -> staged ramp. pinning model-serving config v2.1 for this rollout. @sam @kevin pls watch. I'll post the exact config below.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: schema lint ✅, unit checks ✅, conflict check ✅. canary bundle: config_v2.1-canary.tar.gz created.

joanne: rollout criteria: if error_rate > 0.5% or P95 latency > 1200ms for 5m -> immediate rollback. manual rollback command: `/deploy rollback config_v2.1` or unpin via console.

sam: ack. I'll be on call 22:50-23:40. monitoring on.

kevin: observability dashboards: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/routing-latency and canary stream https://console.redwood/ops/canary/1709001123 - alert set for error_rate > 0.3% (warn) and >0.5% (critical).

anuj: quick config suggestion: increase request timeout to 1800ms to avoid tail timeouts on larger seqs. current models sometimes spike. thoughts?

joanne: want to avoid increasing cost/latency for typical requests. let's keep timeout_ms = 1500 for canary and monitor tails, we can bump in next patch if needed.

joanne: config snippet applied to canary (sanitized):
```json
{
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "routing_weights": {"stable_variant": 0.93, "fallback_variant": 0.07},
  "max_batch_tokens": 1024,
  "batch_window_ms": 12,
  "timeout_ms": 1500,
  "rate_limit_per_min": 6000,
  "pin_model_version": "v2.1-config-rollout"
}
```

deploy-bot: scheduled start: 2024-03-01T23:00:00-08:00. executing canary now.

observability-bot: canary traffic started at 23:00. live metrics will stream to the dashboard.

deploy-bot: canary update: 5% traffic healthy after 3m. P95=420ms, error_rate=0.02%.

sam: seeing normal traces, no 5xx spike. +1 to progress.

kevin: noticing a small tail at 98th percentile for long prompts, still under threshold. continuing.

joanne: ramp to 20% now. canary_percent -> 20. keep same config.

deploy-bot: ramping to 20% — ETA ~2m.

observability-bot: 20% snapshot: P95=460ms, error_rate=0.03%. no alerts.

anuj: good to go, no regressions in quality evals.

sam: will watch the 23:15-23:25 window for any drift. alert hooks active.

deploy-bot: automatic watch: if error_rate > 0.5% OR P95 > 1200ms for 5m -> rollback initiated.

kevin: let's keep the fail-safe: if any service-level queue length increases > 30% across GPU pools -> pause rollout.

deploy-bot: pacing to 50% now.

observability-bot: 50% metrics: P95=490ms, error_rate=0.04%, queue_length +8%. all green.

joanne: rolling to 100% in 3 minutes if no flags. last call for objections.

sam: no objections.

anuj: no objections.

deploy-bot: rolling to 100% traffic.

observability-bot: final snapshot at 23:18: P95=515ms, error_rate=0.05%, queue_length +12%. within thresholds.

joanne: confirmed rolled to 100% and pinned config_v2.1. documenting rollout notes and linking to release page.

joanne: post-rollout actions: 1) follow-up ticket to consider timeout bump for long-prompts (assign @anuj) 2) add an additional canary eval set for long-tail prompts 3) monitor cost impact for 24h.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. change window closed. tagging thread for postmortem if any regressions appear. :tada:

sam: thanks team. closing thread unless any regressions in next 24h.
